# pGenie

> pGenie is a SQL-first code generator for PostgreSQL: validates SQL, manages indexes, and generates type-safe client SDKs from plain migrations and queries.

## Docs

- [Full documentation index](https://pgenie.io/docs/llms.txt): complete machine-readable index of guides, reference, and tutorials
- [Full documentation content](https://pgenie.io/docs/llms-full.txt): complete machine-readable content of all docs pages
- [Documentation](https://pgenie.io/docs/): human-readable docs site

## Comparisons

- [pGenie vs sqlc](https://pgenie.io/docs/comparisons/sqlc/)
- [pGenie vs jOOQ](https://pgenie.io/docs/comparisons/jooq/)
- [pGenie vs Spring Data JDBC](https://pgenie.io/docs/comparisons/spring-data-jdbc/)
